name: nuclear receptor coactivator 4

function.text: NCOA4 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 4. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity. It participates in autophagy and erythrocyte differentiation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Papillary thyroid carcinoma; Intraductal carcinoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
